prompt: set up CI for my Rojo project
texts: I'll look at the project first so I can tell you what I plan to set up.

Here's what I think you want: CI that automatically checks the Rojo project `arena` on push or pull request, so broken builds get caught before merge.

I looked at the project. It's a Rojo project with `src/shared`, `src/client`, and `src/server`, plus `pesde.toml` (Vide, plus Blink as a dev dependency) and `wally.toml` (Janitor, LemonSignal, Charm). It has no git repo, no `CLAUDE.md`, no existing CI, and no formatter, linter, or test setup.

Before I build anything, I need two answers:

1. **Shared or personal?** Shared means the CI config and agent setup are committed to the repo and the team gets them. Personal keeps everything out of Git and CI. CI only runs from a repo on a host, so pick shared if this will live on GitHub. I recommend **shared**.
2. **Where will the repo live?** I recommend **GitHub with GitHub Actions**. If you already have a remote or a different host, tell me which. If there's no remote yet, I can set up the workflow file and you can push it when you're ready.
